turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Right: "Last night our cat caught a mouse." Wrong: "Last night our cat catched a mouse." Catch has its own past form, caught, so we do not add -ed.
Let me think aloud with one example: "Last spring the swallows came back." Step 1: last spring tells me it is the past. Step 2: the verb is come. Step 3: come has its own past form, came.
Now you try. Write one word:
Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
